description: This file defines the Signable class used for creating signable objects from HTTP requests, chunks, or canonical requests, primarily for AWS SDK signing purposes.

classes.name: Signable
classes.description: Represents a signable entity for AWS request signing, capable of being created from HTTP requests, chunks, or canonical requests.

methods.name: fromHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from an HTTP message.

methods.name: fromChunk
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a chunk stream, with an optional previous signature.

methods.name: fromCanonicalRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a canonical request string.
